note: The documented descent, openable generation by generation. Living people are omitted entirely — where a generation is missing from the bottom of a branch, that is why. Colour on the left edge is confidence: solid for documented, dashed for inferred, dotted for family lore.

root.name: Giovanni Defranceschi
root.note: On the family's own chart, and implied by the «q. Joannis» of the next generation but one. No register page yet.

kids.name: Giovanni Battista Defranceschi
kids.note: Agricola. Born 13 August 1787, married 1819. Wife Francisca Salomon, b. 17 March 1797.

kids.name: Raymundus
kids.note: Eldest of four sons.

kids.name: Antonio Defranceschi
kids.note: Lapicida — a stonecutter. «q. Joannis», son of the late Giovanni: the three words that weld house 5 to house 19. Wife Maria née Fernasar, b. 17 October 1832.

kids.name: Antonio DeFranceschi
kids.note: Josip's elder brother by six and a half years, and head of the American reunion album. Eleven children, in five countries.

kids.name: Josip Defranceschi
kids.note: Baptised 22 March 1863, entry 23. «Vešti klesar sada tvorničar» — a skilled stonemason, later a factory worker. Married Ana Kalanj, b. 3 January 1864.

kids.name: Anton Rudolf Defranceski
kids.note: Born 20 January 1890 at Klenovica house 22, baptised 9 February. The zavičaj entry names Gallignana in Istria. Married Ursula Kovačina.

kids.name: Josip «Pepe»
kids.note: Married Božica Blašković, 1911–1994. Photographed on the pier.

kids.name: Toni
kids.note: Their son.

kids.name: Petar
kids.note: Ship's engineer, later Auto-Mechaniker. Left for Germany April 1939 and stayed. IRO 148.902. Married Luise Salzer, b. Neuhausen 5 October 1919, entered on the index cards as apatride. Two daughters, born 1940 and 1945, omitted here as possibly living.

kids.name: Zdravko «Frank»
kids.note: Taken by the Partisans in 1943; motor mechanic at Reutlingen. IRO 148.901. Sailed for Australia 8 March 1949. Married Ruža Hreljac, 1922–1996, of Fužine.

kids.name: Anton
kids.note: The child written «enfant» in red across a French camp card. Buried at Warrill Park, Willowbank.

kids.name: Ivan Defranceski
kids.note: Born 25 June 1925. Entered a Reutlingen factory in October 1941, aged sixteen — and went home. Married Hedviga Blažević of Senj, 1926–2001. Buried under a slab cut IVAN DEFRANČESKI.

kids.name: The living
kids.note: Omitted by standing rule. Two further generations descend from here, including the keeper of this archive.

kids.name: Anka
kids.note: Named in the family's file with no dates at all.

kids.name: Marija Stjepanka
kids.note: Dead at twelve. Her burial entry gives her mother's full style, Ana Kalaj-Kučarica.

kids.name: Ivan
kids.note: Dead at two, of «dobrac», buried 28 March 1896.

kids.name: Zorica
kids.note: Born 14 December 1896 — conceived the month her brother Ivan died.

kids.name: Marija
kids.note: Three months and fifteen days. Pneumonia.

kids.name: Joannes
kids.note: Third son.

kids.name: Franciscus
kids.note: Fourth son.
